rows.en: Nobody out here waters anything until that sun is properly behind the hill.
rows.text: Niemand hier buite maak iets nat voor daardie son behoorlik agter die bult is nie.
rows.back: Nobody out here waters anything before that sun is properly behind the hill.

rows.en: It was watered this morning and you would not know it from here.
rows.text: Dit is vanoggend natgemaak en van hier af sou jy dit nie sê nie.
rows.back: It was watered this morning and from here you'd never say so.

rows.en: That pot has been in full sun since about eleven this morning.
rows.text: Daardie pot staan sedert omtrent elfuur vanoggend in vol son.
rows.back: That pot has been standing in full sun since about eleven this morning.

rows.en: Monday, and it will do all of that again tomorrow without being asked.
rows.text: Maandag, en dit gaan môre alles weer doen sonder dat iemand vra.
rows.back: Monday, and it's going to do all of it again tomorrow without anyone asking.

rows.en: 7pm and still 30 degrees. The Karoo doesn't make mistakes, only statements.
rows.text: 19:00 en steeds 30 grade. Die Karoo maak nie foute nie, net stellings.
rows.back: 19:00 and still 30 degrees. The Karoo doesn't make mistakes, only statements.

rows.en: That water has been topped up twice and it is still the wrong temperature.
rows.text: Daardie water is twee keer opgevul en dit is steeds die verkeerde temperatuur.
rows.back: That water has been topped up twice and it's still the wrong temperature.

rows.en: That water has been sitting in the sun all day and it is not cold.
rows.text: Daardie water staan die hele dag in die son en dit is nie koud nie.
rows.back: That water stands in the sun all day and it's not cold.

rows.en: He got in at eleven this morning and this is the second filling.
rows.text: Hy het elfuur vanoggend ingeklim en dis al die tweede keer dat dit volgemaak is.
rows.back: He got in at eleven this morning and it's already the second time it's been filled up.

rows.en: The sun went down an hour ago and the paving is still giving it back.
rows.text: Die son is 'n uur gelede weg en die plaveisel gee dit steeds terug.
rows.back: The sun went down an hour ago and the paving is still giving it back.

rows.en: Tuesday, and the coolest thing in this entire garden is that dog.
rows.text: Dinsdag, en die koelste ding in hierdie hele tuin is daardie hond.
rows.back: Tuesday, and the coolest thing in this whole garden is that dog.

rows.en: Her eyes are closed and that fan is aimed at exactly one person.
rows.text: Haar oë is toe en daardie waaier is op presies een persoon gerig.
rows.back: Her eyes are closed and that fan is aimed at exactly one person.

rows.en: That jug has been refilled twice and it is not even properly dark yet.
rows.text: Daardie kan is al twee keer weer volgemaak, en dis nog nie eers behoorlik donker nie.
rows.back: That jug has been refilled twice already, and it's not even properly dark yet.

rows.en: The sun has gone and the tiles are still giving it back.
rows.text: Die son is weg en die teëls gee dit steeds terug.
rows.back: The sun is gone and the tiles are still giving it back.

rows.en: Nobody else in this house is getting near that fan tonight.
rows.text: Niemand anders in hierdie huis kom vanaand naby daardie waaier nie.
rows.back: Nobody else in this house is getting near that fan tonight.

rows.en: Wednesday, and this is the first comfortable minute she has had since eleven.
rows.text: Woensdag, en dit is die eerste gemaklike minuut wat sy sedert elfuur gehad het.
rows.back: Wednesday, and this is the first comfortable minute she's had since eleven.

rows.en: Stay hydrated or become a biltong.
rows.text: Bly gehidreer of word biltong.
rows.back: Stay hydrated or become biltong.

rows.en: That grass has been too hot to stand on since about eleven this morning.
rows.text: Daardie gras is sedert omtrent elfuur vanoggend te warm om op te staan.
rows.back: That grass has been too hot to stand on since about eleven this morning.

rows.en: Thursday, and this is the first time all day either of them has been cool.
rows.text: Donderdag, en dit is die eerste keer die hele dag dat een van hulle koel is.
rows.back: Thursday, and this is the first time all day that one of them is cool.

rows.en: The sun left an hour ago and took none of the heat with it.
rows.text: Die son is 'n uur gelede weg en het niks van die hitte saamgevat nie.
rows.back: The sun left an hour ago and took none of the heat with it.

rows.en: Supper can wait. At this temperature the sprinkler promotes itself to family pool.
rows.text: Aandete kan wag. By hierdie temperatuur bevorder die sproeier homself tot gesinswembad.
rows.back: Dinner can wait. At this temperature the sprinkler promotes itself to family pool.

rows.en: Officially he’s watering the garden. The garden is third in the queue.
rows.text: Amptelik gee hy die tuin water. Die tuin is derde in die tou.
rows.back: Officially he's watering the garden. The garden is third in the queue.

rows.en: The ice cream is losing and all three of them know it.
rows.text: Die roomys verloor en al drie van hulle weet dit.
rows.back: The ice cream is losing and all three of them know it.

rows.en: Friday, and this promenade is doing the work of six different bars.
rows.text: Vrydag, en hierdie promenade doen die werk van ses verskillende kroeë.
rows.back: Friday, and this promenade is doing the work of six different bars.

rows.en: Everybody came out at exactly the same time and nobody planned it.
rows.text: Almal het presies dieselfde tyd uitgekom en niemand het dit beplan nie.
rows.back: Everyone came out at exactly the same time and nobody planned it.

rows.en: The light will be gone in nine minutes and nobody is hurrying.
rows.text: Die lig is oor nege minute weg en niemand haas hom nie.
rows.back: The light will be gone in nine minutes and nobody's rushing it.
rows.note: 'niemand haas hom nie' = nobody's hurrying it along / nobody's in a hurry

rows.en: That dog has walked this stretch more times than any of them.
rows.text: Daardie hond het hierdie stuk meer kere geloop as enigeen van hulle.
rows.back: That dog has walked this stretch more times than any of them.

rows.en: Still warm enough at sunset that the ice cream is doing the sweating.
rows.text: Nog warm genoeg met sonsak dat die roomys die sweet doen.
rows.back: Still warm enough at sunset that the ice cream is doing the sweating.

rows.en: Nobody drives past a stall like that on a day like this.
rows.text: Niemand ry op 'n dag soos vandag by so 'n stalletjie verby nie.
rows.back: Nobody drives past a stall like that on a day like today.

rows.en: Watermelon weather: the whole province agreed on it by about ten this morning.
rows.text: Waatlemoenweer: die hele provinsie het teen omtrent tienuur vanoggend saamgestem.
rows.back: Watermelon weather: the whole province had agreed by about ten this morning.

rows.en: The windpomp has stopped turning, which is how you know the day is over.
rows.text: Die windpomp het opgehou draai, en so weet jy die dag is verby.
rows.back: The windmill has stopped turning, and that's how you know the day is done.

rows.en: That glass has been full for an hour and she is in no hurry.
rows.text: Daardie glas is al 'n uur vol en sy is glad nie haastig nie.
rows.back: That glass has been full for an hour and she's in no hurry at all.

rows.en: Sunday, and the Karoo is doing the one thing it does better than anywhere.
rows.text: Sondag, en die Karoo doen die een ding wat hy beter as enige plek doen.
rows.back: Sunday, and the Karoo is doing the one thing it does better than anywhere else.

rows.en: The stoep step is still warm and will be for another hour yet.
rows.text: Die stoeptrap is nog warm en gaan nog 'n uur so bly.
rows.back: The stoep step is still warm and will stay that way for another hour.

rows.en: Nobody has switched a light on inside yet and nobody intends to.
rows.text: Niemand het nog 'n lig binne aangesit nie, en niemand gaan ook nie.
rows.back: Nobody has switched on a light inside yet, and nobody's going to.

rows.en: Two in the morning, and that fan has been the loudest thing in the house.
rows.text: Tweeuur die oggend, en daardie waaier was die hardste ding in die huis.
rows.back: Two in the morning, and that fan was the loudest thing in the house.

rows.en: The glass of water was a very good idea about four hours ago.
rows.text: Die glas water was omtrent vier uur gelede 'n baie goeie idee.
rows.back: The glass of water was a very good idea about four hours ago.

rows.en: The net is handling mosquitoes. The fan is handling everything else.
rows.text: Die net hanteer muskiete. Die waaier hanteer al die res.
rows.back: The net handles mosquitoes. The fan handles everything else.

rows.en: Monday starts in five hours and that fan is not going off.
rows.text: Maandag begin oor vyf uur en daardie waaier gaan nie af nie.
rows.back: Monday starts in five hours and that fan isn't going off.

rows.en: Somebody has already turned the pillow over twice tonight.
rows.text: Iemand het die kussing vanaand al twee keer omgedraai.
rows.back: Someone has already flipped the pillow twice tonight.

rows.en: The fan is on its third shift and the night is still not cooling.
rows.text: Die waaier is op sy derde skof en die nag koel steeds nie af nie.
rows.back: The fan is on its third shift and the night still isn't cooling down.

rows.en: She is not looking for anything and both of us know it.
rows.text: Sy soek niks nie en ons weet dit albei.
rows.back: She's not looking for anything and we both know it.

findings: MEDIUM morphology: negation 'niks' without the closing 'nie' at the end of the clause

rows.en: That door has been open about ninety seconds and it is staying open.
rows.text: Daardie deur is omtrent negentig sekondes oop en dit bly oop.
rows.back: That door has been open about ninety seconds and it's staying open.

rows.en: It has not dropped below twenty-five in that house since about Tuesday.
rows.text: Dit het sedert omtrent Dinsdag nie onder vyf-en-twintig in daardie huis gesak nie.
rows.back: It hasn't dropped below twenty-five in that house since about Tuesday.

rows.en: That is the third time tonight and not one of them is about food.
rows.text: Dit is die derde keer vanaand en nie een van hulle gaan oor kos nie.
rows.back: This is the third time tonight and not one of them is about food.

rows.en: The fridge is the coolest room in the house.
rows.text: Die yskas is die koelste kamer in die huis.
rows.back: The fridge is the coolest room in the house.

rows.en: The fridge door is getting a workout today.
rows.text: Die yskasdeur kry baie oefening vandag.
rows.back: The fridge door is getting a lot of exercise today.

rows.en: Shorts weather? This is underwear weather.
rows.text: Kortbroekie weer? Dis onderbroekie weer.
rows.back: Shorts weather? It's undies weather.
rows.note: unsure: 'weer' written as a separate word — reads as 'weather' (compound split) but could be 'again': 'Shorts again? It's undies again.'
rows.reason: Split compounds 'Kortbroekie weer? ... onderbroekie weer' let 'weer' read as 'again' ('Shorts again? It's undies again'); solid 'kortbroekieweer / onderbroekieweer' keeps the weather joke.
reasons: DRIFT: Split compounds 'Kortbroekie weer? ... onderbroekie weer' let 'weer' read as 'again' ('Shorts again? It's undies again'); solid 'kortbroekieweer / onderbroekieweer' keeps the weather joke.

rows.en: The dog has worked out where the coldest tiles in the house are.
rows.text: Die hond het uitgevind waar die koelste teëls in die huis is.
rows.back: The dog has worked out where the coolest tiles in the house are.

rows.en: That is the bathroom floor and it is now his bedroom.
rows.text: Dit is die badkamervloer en dit is nou sy slaapkamer.
rows.back: It's the bathroom floor and it's now his bedroom.

rows.en: Nobody in this house is getting into that bath tonight.
rows.text: Niemand in hierdie huis klim vanaand in daardie bad nie.
rows.back: Nobody in this house is getting into that bath tonight.
rows.note: why is unstated (dog in it? too hot?)

rows.en: He has been lying there since about eight and has no further plans.
rows.text: Hy lê daar sedert omtrent agtuur en het geen verdere planne nie.
rows.back: He's been lying there since about eight o'clock and has no further plans.

rows.en: Wednesday, and the dog has made the only sensible decision so far.
rows.text: Woensdag, en die hond het tot dusver die enigste sinvolle besluit geneem.
rows.back: Wednesday, and so far the dog has made the only sensible decision.

rows.en: The ceiling fan is doing its best, but its best is not enough.
rows.text: Die plafonventilator probeer sy bes, maar sy bes is nie genoeg nie.
rows.back: The ceiling fan is doing its best, but its best isn't good enough.

rows.en: Tile is the coldest surface in the house tonight, and it is taken.
rows.text: Teël is vanaand die koudste oppervlak in die huis, en dit is gevat.
rows.back: Tile is the coldest surface in the house tonight, and it's taken.

rows.en: Thursday night, and the balcony has been promoted to the main room.
rows.text: Donderdagaand, en die balkon is tot hoofkamer bevorder.
rows.back: Thursday night, and the balcony has been promoted to main bedroom.

rows.en: It is cooler out here at midnight than it was inside at six.
rows.text: Dit is hier buite om middernag koeler as wat dit sesuur binne was.
rows.back: It's cooler out here at midnight than it was inside at six.

rows.en: The ice in that jug never stood a chance and everybody knew it.
rows.text: Die ys in daardie kan het nooit 'n kans gestaan nie, en almal het dit geweet.
rows.back: The ice in that jug never stood a chance, and everyone knew it.

rows.en: That curtain is the only moving air in the entire flat.
rows.text: Daardie gordyn is die enigste bewegende lug in die hele woonstel.
rows.back: That curtain is the only moving air in the whole flat.

rows.en: Nobody is going back in there until the walls let go of the day.
rows.text: Niemand gaan daar terug in voor die mure die dag laat gaan nie.
rows.back: Nobody's going back in there before the walls let go of the day.

rows.en: Ice in the jug, fan on the chair: the night shift of a forty-degree day.
rows.text: Ys in die kan, waaier op die stoel: die nagskof van 'n veertig-grade-dag.
rows.back: Ice in the jug, fan on the chair: the night shift of a forty-degree day.

rows.en: Too warm to sleep inside, so the whole family moved under the Milky Way.
rows.text: Te warm om binne te slaap, so die hele gesin het onder die Melkweg ingetrek.
rows.back: Too hot to sleep inside, so the whole family has moved in under the Milky Way.

rows.en: Somebody left the light on inside and nobody is going back for it.
rows.text: Iemand het die lig binne aangelos en niemand gaan terug daarvoor nie.
rows.back: Someone left the light on inside and nobody's going back for it.

rows.en: The youngest is still awake and has decided the sky is worth it.
rows.text: Die kleinste is nog wakker en het besluit die lug is dit werd.
rows.back: The littlest one is still awake and has decided the sky is worth it.

rows.en: Five mattresses on a stoep, and not one of them is a compromise.
rows.text: Vyf matrasse op 'n stoep, en nie een van hulle is 'n kompromie nie.
rows.back: Five mattresses on a stoep, and not one of them is a compromise.

rows.en: Friday night, and the ceiling has been upgraded considerably.
rows.text: Vrydagaand, en die plafon is aansienlik opgegradeer.
rows.back: Friday night, and the ceiling has been considerably upgraded.

rows.en: Too hot for walls tonight: the whole family moved the bedroom outside.
rows.text: Te warm vir mure vanaand: die hele gesin het die slaapkamer buitentoe geskuif.
rows.back: Too hot for walls tonight: the whole family has moved the bedroom outside.

rows.en: Nobody has been inside that house since about four this afternoon.
rows.text: Niemand was sedert omtrent vieruur vanmiddag binne daardie huis nie.
rows.back: Nobody has been inside that house since about four this afternoon.

rows.en: The pool has been the only sensible room in the place all day.
rows.text: Die swembad is die hele dag die enigste kamer op die plek wat sin maak.
rows.back: The pool is the only room on the property that has made sense all day.

rows.en: Those beers on the edge are on their third owner tonight.
rows.text: Daardie biere op die rand is vanaand op hul derde eienaar.
rows.back: Those beers on the edge are on their third owner tonight.

rows.en: Saturday, and the water is still warmer than the air above it.
rows.text: Saterdag, en die water is steeds warmer as die lug daarbo.
rows.back: Saturday, and the water is still warmer than the air above it.

rows.en: The lights went on two hours ago and nobody has suggested moving.
rows.text: Die ligte het twee uur gelede aangegaan en niemand het nog voorgestel ons skuif nie.
rows.back: The lights came on two hours ago and nobody has suggested we move yet.

rows.en: Night swimming is not a plan; it is what this weather leaves you.
rows.text: Nagswem is nie 'n plan nie; dis al wat hierdie weer vir jou oorlaat.
rows.back: Night swimming isn't a plan; it's all this weather leaves you.

rows.en: The ice in that glass has about four minutes left.
rows.text: Die ys in daardie glas het omtrent vier minute oor.
rows.back: The ice in that glass has about four minutes left.

rows.en: Sunday night, and this promenade is busier than it was all afternoon.
rows.text: Sondagaand, en hierdie promenade is besiger as wat dit die hele middag was.
rows.back: Sunday evening, and this promenade is busier than it was all afternoon.

rows.en: The whole town waited for the sun to go down and then came outside.
rows.text: Die hele dorp het gewag dat die son sak en toe eers uitgekom.
rows.back: The whole town waited for the sun to go down and only then came out.

rows.en: That water was cold when somebody put it down there.
rows.text: Daardie water was koud toe iemand dit daar neergesit het.
rows.back: That water was cold when someone put it down there.

rows.en: Nine at night and the paving is still handing back the afternoon.
rows.text: Nege-uur die aand en die plaveisel gee die middag nog terug.
rows.back: Nine at night and the paving is still giving back the afternoon.
rows.note: i.e. still radiating the afternoon's heat

rows.en: Night has not cooled anything yet; even the water is perspiring.
rows.text: Die nag het nog niks afgekoel nie; selfs die water sweet.
rows.back: The night hasn't cooled down at all yet; even the water is sweating.

rows.en: The puddles are claiming the pavement one slab at a time.
rows.text: Die plasse eis die sypaadjie op, een blok op 'n slag.
rows.back: The puddles are claiming the sidewalk, one block at a time.

rows.en: The traffic is emotional.
rows.text: Die verkeer is emosioneel.
rows.back: The traffic is emotional.

rows.en: The wipers are on max and it's still not enough.
rows.text: Die wipers is op max en dit is steeds nie genoeg nie.
rows.back: The wipers are on max and it's still not enough.

rows.en: The wiper is on its ten-thousandth swipe and the rain has not blinked.
rows.text: Die ruitveër is op sy tienduisendste veeg en die reën het nie eers geknip nie.
rows.back: The wiper is on its ten-thousandth wipe and the rain hasn't even blinked.

rows.en: Your shoes are about to have a bad day.
rows.text: Jou skoene gaan 'n slegte dag hê.
rows.back: Your shoes are going to have a bad day.

rows.en: Rain on a farm isn't weather. It's a salary falling from the sky.
rows.text: Reën op 'n plaas is nie weer nie. Dis 'n salaris wat val.
rows.back: Rain on a farm isn't weather. It's a salary falling from the sky.

rows.en: The dams are doing a happy dance.
rows.text: Die damme doen 'n bly dansie.
rows.back: The dams are doing a happy little dance.

rows.en: One night of proper rain and the driveway has joined the water table.
rows.text: Een nag se ordentlike reën en die oprit het by die watertafel aangesluit.
rows.back: One night of proper rain and the driveway has joined the water table.

rows.en: Somewhere a farmer is doing a small private dance nobody's allowed to see.
rows.text: Iewers doen 'n boer nou 'n klein dansie wat niemand mag sien nie.
rows.back: Somewhere a farmer is doing a little dance right now that nobody is allowed to see.

rows.en: The dams get their drink before you get your coffee. Know your place.
rows.text: Die damme drink eerste. Jy kry jou koffie tweede.
rows.back: The dams drink first. You get your coffee second.

rows.en: Rain out here is an event; the whole veld will smell of it by seven.
rows.text: Reën hier buite is 'n gebeurtenis; die hele veld gaan teen sewe daarna ruik.
rows.back: Rain out here is an event; the whole veld will smell of it by seven.

rows.en: Wet tar plus sunrise equals a street made of gold, briefly.
rows.text: Nat teer plus sonop is gelyk aan 'n straat van goud, vir 'n rukkie.
rows.back: Wet tar plus sunrise equals a street of gold, for a little while.

rows.en: Somebody ordered rain for the night and sun for the morning, and it was delivered.
rows.text: Iemand het reën vir die nag en son vir die oggend bestel, en dit is afgelewer.
rows.back: Someone ordered rain for the night and sun for the morning, and it was delivered.

rows.en: The rain is on the glass and the coffee is on the sill: Sunday is sorted.
rows.text: Reën teen die glas en koffie op die vensterbank: Sondag is gereël.
rows.back: Rain against the glass and coffee on the windowsill: Sunday is sorted.

rows.en: That window has the best programme on this morning and it is just rain.
rows.text: Daardie venster het vanoggend die beste program, en dit is net reën.
rows.back: That window has the best show on this morning, and it's just rain.

rows.en: Steady, straight-down, all-morning rain: the kind the garden actually drinks.
rows.text: Egalige, reguit-af, heeloggend-reën: die soort wat die tuin werklik drink.
rows.back: Steady, straight-down, all-morning rain: the kind the garden actually drinks.

rows.en: Clouds are crying like NZ at the 23 Rugby WC!
rows.text: Die wolke huil soos die All Blacks ná die 2023-Wêreldbeker!
rows.back: The clouds are crying like the All Blacks after the 2023 World Cup!

rows.en: Breaking news: the puddles are open for business.
rows.text: Groot nuus: die plasse is oop vir besigheid.
rows.back: Big news: the puddles are open for business.

rows.en: The rain made the puddle; the puddle made the afternoon.
rows.text: Die reën het die plas gemaak; die plas het die middag gemaak.
rows.back: The rain made the puddle; the puddle made the afternoon.

rows.en: Six raincoats, one puddle, zero regrets: the rain knows its audience.
rows.text: Ses reënjasse, een plas, nul spyt: die reën ken sy gehoor.
rows.back: Six raincoats, one puddle, zero regrets: the rain knows its audience.

rows.en: Rain turns every South African driver back into a learner. Hazards on, dignity off.
rows.text: Reën verander elke Suid-Afrikaanse bestuurder terug in 'n leerling.
rows.back: Rain turns every South African driver back into a learner.
rows.reason: Drops the tag 'Hazards on, dignity off'; core joke (back to learner) intact and the drop is canon-sanctioned (af-voice rule 2, C293).

rows.en: The clouds are having a moment.
rows.text: Die wolke het 'n oomblik.
rows.back: The clouds are having a moment.
rows.note: calque of the English idiom 'having a moment'
rows.reason: 'Die wolke het 'n oomblik' is a word-for-word calque of 'having a moment'; the idiom does not exist in Afrikaans (af-voice anti-pattern 1 names this exact line).
reasons: DRIFT: 'Die wolke het 'n oomblik' is a word-for-word calque of 'having a moment'; the idiom does not exist in Afrikaans (af-voice anti-pattern 1 names this exact line).

rows.en: Rain so heavy it should pay rent.
rows.text: Reën so swaar dit moet huur betaal.
rows.back: Rain so heavy it should be paying rent.

rows.en: The cat has taken the rain personally, as the cat takes most things.
rows.text: Die kat vat die reën persoonlik op, soos die kat die meeste dinge opvat.
rows.back: The cat is taking the rain personally, the way the cat takes most things.

rows.en: Dry spot found; dignity pending; the rain shows no sign of apologising.
rows.text: Droë kol gekry; waardigheid hangende; die reën wys geen teken van verskoning nie.
rows.back: Found a dry spot; dignity pending; the rain shows no sign of apologising.

rows.en: Yes, it's raining sideways. South Africa speciality.
rows.text: Ja, dit reën sywaarts. Suid-Afrikaanse spesialiteit.
rows.back: Yes, it's raining sideways. South African speciality.

rows.en: Hair plans: cancelled.
rows.text: Haarplanne: gekanselleer.
rows.back: Hair plans: cancelled.

rows.en: Rain came all the way home.
rows.text: Die reën het die hele pad saam huis toe gekom.
rows.back: The rain came along the whole way home.

rows.en: It's proper rain. The day's over in stages.
rows.text: Dis ordentlike reën. Die dag is klaar, in fases.
rows.back: That's proper rain. The day is done, in phases.

rows.en: Still raining. That's the whole update.
rows.text: Dit reën nog. Dis die hele opdatering.
rows.back: Still raining. That's the whole update.

rows.en: Wet between here and anywhere else.
rows.text: Nat tussen hier en enige ander plek.
rows.back: Wet between here and anywhere else.

rows.en: Perfect excuse to cancel plans.
rows.text: Perfekte verskoning om planne te kanselleer.
rows.back: Perfect excuse to cancel plans.

rows.en: The N1 is now a waterpark.
rows.text: Die N1 is nou 'n waterpark.
rows.back: The N1 is now a water park.

rows.en: Two drops on a windscreen and the whole N1 forgets everything it ever learned.
rows.text: Twee druppels op die voorruit en die hele N1 vergeet hoe om te bestuur.
rows.back: Two drops on the windscreen and the whole N1 forgets how to drive.

rows.en: Joburg rains for twenty minutes, then paints the sky like nothing happened.
rows.text: Joburg reën twintig minute en verf dan die lug asof niks gebeur het nie.
rows.back: Joburg rains for twenty minutes and then paints the sky as if nothing happened.

rows.en: Joburg summer rain: arrives at five, soaks everything, gone by supper.
rows.text: Joburg somerreën: kom vyfuur, deurweek alles, weg teen aandete.
rows.back: Joburg summer rain: arrives at five, soaks everything, gone by dinner.

rows.en: The commute just became a team sport.
rows.text: Die rit het 'n spansport geword.
rows.back: The drive has become a team sport.

rows.en: Wet socks. The ultimate betrayal.
rows.text: Nat sokkies. Die finale verraad.
rows.back: Wet socks. The final betrayal.

rows.en: Still raining. That's the update.
rows.text: Dit reën nog. Dis die opdatering.
rows.back: Still raining. That's the update.

rows.en: The rain didn't clock off.
rows.text: Die reën het nie uitgeklok nie.
rows.back: The rain hasn't clocked out.

rows.en: Rain on an otherwise good-looking evening.
rows.text: Reën op 'n andersins mooi aand.
rows.back: Rain on an otherwise lovely evening.

rows.en: Wet out. The city can keep the colour.
rows.text: Nat daar buite. Die stad kan die kleur hou.
rows.back: Wet out there. The city can keep the colour.
rows.note: unclear: 'die kleur hou' — keep the colour / hold the colour

rows.en: The frangipani is dropping flowers all over the paving and taking no responsibility.
rows.text: Die frangipani laat blomme oor die hele plaveisel val en vat geen verantwoordelikheid nie.
rows.back: The frangipani drops flowers all over the paving and takes no responsibility.

rows.en: Monday night, one lit window, and the rain doing all the talking.
rows.text: Maandagaand, een verligte venster, en die reën doen al die praatwerk.
rows.back: Monday evening, one lit window, and the rain does all the talking.

rows.en: That wall has a damp line on it older than tonight's storm.
rows.text: Daardie muur het 'n voglyn ouer as vanaand se storm.
rows.back: That wall has a damp line older than tonight's storm.

rows.en: The burglar bars are the only straight lines left in the whole street.
rows.text: Die diefwering is die enigste reguit lyne wat in die hele straat oor is.
rows.back: The burglar bars are the only straight lines left in the whole street.

rows.en: Somebody inside has already decided they are not going anywhere tonight.
rows.text: Iemand binne het reeds besluit hulle gaan vanaand nêrens heen nie.
rows.back: Someone inside has already decided they're not going anywhere tonight.

rows.en: The pool is measurably fuller than it was at supper time.
rows.text: Die swembad is meetbaar voller as wat dit met aandete was.
rows.back: The pool is measurably fuller than it was at dinner.

rows.en: Nobody is going to have to top that up for a month.
rows.text: Niemand gaan dit vir 'n maand hoef by te vul nie.
rows.back: Nobody's going to have to top it up for a month.

rows.en: The pool light is the only thing in this garden still doing its job.
rows.text: Die swembadlig is die enigste ding in hierdie tuin wat nog sy werk doen.
rows.back: The pool light is the only thing in this garden still doing its job.

rows.en: Tuesday night, and the pool is having a far better time than anyone.
rows.text: Dinsdagaand, en die swembad geniet dit meer as enigiemand.
rows.back: Tuesday evening, and the pool is enjoying it more than anyone.

rows.en: The paving has stopped absorbing anything and is just passing it along.
rows.text: Die plaveisel absorbeer niks meer nie en gee dit net aan.
rows.back: The paving isn't absorbing anything any more and just passes it on.

findings: MEDIUM morphology: negation 'niks' without the closing 'nie' at the end of the clause

rows.en: The pool is being topped up by head office tonight, free of charge.
rows.text: Die swembad word vanaand deur hoofkantoor vol gemaak, gratis.
rows.back: The pool is being filled tonight by head office, free of charge.

findings: MEDIUM semantic: 'vol' means 'full; complete' — nothing in the English source; it is 1 letter from 'tol', the usual word for 'topped'

rows.en: The only thing swimming tonight is the water itself.
rows.text: Die enigste ding wat vanaand swem is die water self.
rows.back: The only thing swimming tonight is the water itself.

rows.en: The pool is getting topped up for free tonight. Somewhere a water bill relaxes.
rows.text: Die swembad word vanaand gratis vol gemaak. Iewers ontspan 'n waterrekening.
rows.back: The pool is being filled for free tonight. Somewhere a water bill is relaxing.

findings: MEDIUM semantic: 'vol' means 'full; complete' — nothing in the English source; it is 1 letter from 'tol', the usual word for 'topped'

rows.en: The only one swimming tonight is the rain itself.
rows.text: Die enigste een wat vanaand swem, is die reën self.
rows.back: The only one swimming tonight is the rain itself.

rows.en: The pool light is on for nobody. The rain appreciates the ambience.
rows.text: Die swembadlig brand vir niemand nie. Die reën waardeer die atmosfeer.
rows.back: The pool light is on for nobody. The rain appreciates the atmosphere.

rows.en: The gutter is carrying this street's problems straight down to the next one.
rows.text: Die geut dra hierdie straat se probleme reguit af na die volgende een.
rows.back: The gutter carries this street's problems straight down to the next one.

rows.en: Jacaranda blossom and stormwater, which is Joburg's least favourite combination.
rows.text: Jakarandablomme en stormwater — die kombinasie waarvan Joburg die minste hou.
rows.back: Jacaranda blossoms and stormwater — the combination Joburg likes least.

rows.en: The electric fence is fine. The pavement has completely given up.
rows.text: Die elektriese heining is oukei. Die sypaadjie het heeltemal moed opgegee.
rows.back: The electric fence is fine. The sidewalk has completely given up.

rows.en: Wednesday, and the drive home is going to be a story by tomorrow.
rows.text: Woensdag, en die rit huis toe gaan teen môre 'n storie wees.
rows.back: Wednesday, and the drive home will be a story by tomorrow.

rows.en: Every drain on this road is now working on somebody else's behalf.
rows.text: Elke stormwaterrooster in hierdie straat werk nou namens iemand anders.
rows.back: Every stormwater grate in this street is now working on behalf of someone else.

rows.en: Sleep tight, dams. You worked hard today.
rows.text: Slaap lekker, damme. Julle het vandag hard gewerk.
rows.back: Sleep well, dams. You worked hard today.

rows.en: The pavement is a river and the river has plans.
rows.text: Die sypaadjie is 'n rivier en die rivier het planne.
rows.back: The sidewalk is a river and the river has plans.

rows.en: Rain through a streetlight looks like static, and tonight the whole street is tuned to it.
rows.text: Reën deur 'n straatlig lyk soos ruis, en vanaand is die hele straat daarop ingestel.
rows.back: Rain through a streetlight looks like static, and tonight the whole street is tuned to it.

rows.en: The traffic just remembered rain exists. Again.
rows.text: Die verkeer het pas onthou daar is n ding soos reën bestaan weer.
rows.back: The traffic just remembered there's a thing like rain exists again.
rows.note: ungrammatical Afrikaans: two constructions spliced ('daar is 'n ding soos reën' + 'reën bestaan'), and 'n' without apostrophe
rows.reason: Garbled: 'daar is n ding soos reën bestaan weer' splices two constructions into an ungrammatical sentence (and 'n' lacks its apostrophe); the crisp 'rain exists. Again.' beat is lost.
reasons: MISMATCH: Garbled: 'daar is n ding soos reën bestaan weer' splices two constructions into an ungrammatical sentence (and 'n' lacks its apostrophe); the crisp 'rain exists. Again.' beat is lost.

rows.en: Your car wash was a waste of money.
rows.text: Jou karwas was geldmors.
rows.back: Your car wash was a waste of money.

rows.en: Night rain maths: half the visibility, double the concentration, triple the respect.
rows.text: Nagreënwiskunde: helfte die sig, dubbel die konsentrasie, drie keer die respek.
rows.back: Night-rain maths: half the visibility, double the concentration, three times the respect.
rows.reason: 'helfte die sig' is an English calque of 'half the visibility' (Afrikaans: 'half die sig'); reads machine-made in an otherwise chatty line.

findings: MEDIUM lexical: 'Nagreënwiskunde' — not found in any external source

reasons: DRIFT: 'helfte die sig' is an English calque of 'half the visibility' (Afrikaans: 'half die sig'); reads machine-made in an otherwise chatty line.

rows.en: The gutter is running like a river and it has already claimed a casualty.
rows.text: Die geut loop soos 'n rivier en het reeds 'n slagoffer geëis.
rows.back: The gutter is running like a river and has already claimed a victim.

rows.en: The storm water is heading for the sea and taking prisoners.
rows.text: Die stormwater is see toe op pad en vat gevangenes.
rows.back: The stormwater is on its way to the sea and taking prisoners.

rows.en: That umbrella has been closed since the moment it arrived.
rows.text: Daardie sambreel is toe van die oomblik af dat dit opgedaag het.
rows.back: That umbrella has been closed from the moment it showed up.

rows.en: Every one of those parking bays was somebody's plan for tonight.
rows.text: Elkeen van daardie parkeerplekke was iemand se plan vir vanaand.
rows.back: Every one of those parking bays was someone's plan for tonight.

rows.en: Saturday night at the sea, and the sea has taken the whole promenade.
rows.text: Saterdagaand by die see, en die see het die hele promenade gevat.
rows.back: Saturday night by the sea, and the sea has taken the whole promenade.

rows.en: The painted lines are the only thing out there still holding a shape.
rows.text: Die geverfde lyne is die enigste ding daar buite wat nog 'n vorm hou.
rows.back: The painted lines are the only thing out there still holding a shape.

rows.en: Somebody drove all the way down here to look at this and left.
rows.text: Iemand het die hele pad hierheen gery om hierna te kyk, en toe weer gery.
rows.back: Someone drove all the way here to look at this, and then drove off again.

rows.en: Every neon sign in the street is being doubled on the wet tar tonight.
rows.text: Elke neonbord in die straat word vanaand op die nat teer verdubbel.
rows.back: Every neon sign in the street is doubled on the wet tar tonight.

rows.en: Solidarity to everyone with one wet shoe right now.
rows.text: Solidariteit aan almal met een nat skoen nou.
rows.back: Solidarity to everyone with one wet shoe right now.

rows.en: Wet jeans for the rest of the day. The classic punishment.
rows.text: Nat jeans vir die res van die dag. Die klassieke straf.
rows.back: Wet jeans for the rest of the day. The classic punishment.

rows.en: The umbrella broke on the first gust. Classic.
rows.text: Die sambreel het gebreek met die eerste wind. Klassiek.
rows.back: The umbrella broke at the first gust. Classic.

rows.en: Somewhere an umbrella just turned inside out. Moment of silence.
rows.text: Iewers het 'n sambreel net binnestebuite gedraai. Oomblik van stilte.
rows.back: Somewhere an umbrella just turned inside out. Moment of silence.

rows.en: Joburg rain keeps a diary: 2pm sharp, maximum drama, no apologies.
rows.text: Joburg se reën hou dagboek: 14:00, stiptelik, vol drama.
rows.back: Joburg's rain keeps a diary: 14:00, on the dot, full of drama.

rows.en: The puddle outside the gate is now part of the curriculum.
rows.text: Die plas buite die hek is nou deel van die kurrikulum.
rows.back: The puddle outside the gate is now part of the curriculum.

rows.en: Forgot your jacket? The universe noticed.
rows.text: Jou baadjie vergeet? Die heelal het opgemerk.
rows.back: Forgot your jacket? The universe noticed.

rows.en: Someone's braai just got ruined.
rows.text: Iemand se braai is sopnat.
rows.back: Someone's braai is soaking wet.

rows.en: The garden's saying dankie at last.
rows.text: Die tuin sê uiteindelik dankie.
rows.back: The garden is finally saying thank you.

rows.en: At least the garden's happy. Someone has to be.
rows.text: Ten minste is die tuin bly. Iemand moet wees.
rows.back: At least the garden's happy. Someone has to be.

rows.en: This is why Noah built a boat.
rows.text: Dis hoekom Noag 'n ark gebou het.
rows.back: This is why Noah built an ark.

rows.en: Sunrise chose drama today.
rows.text: Die sonsopkoms het vanoggend op drama besluit.
rows.back: The sunrise went for drama this morning.

rows.en: The sky's CV just got updated.
rows.text: Die lug se CV is pas opgedateer.
rows.back: The sky's CV has just been updated.

rows.en: The dog has already booked his spot under the bed.
rows.text: Die hond het klaar sy plek onder die bed bespreek.
rows.back: The dog has already booked its spot under the bed.

rows.en: The dog's under the bed. Smart move, honestly.
rows.text: Die hond is onder die bed. Slim skuif, eerlikwaar.
rows.back: The dog is under the bed. Smart move, honestly.

rows.en: The sky woke up in a mood.
rows.text: Die lug het wakker geword met 'n houding.
rows.back: The sky woke up with an attitude.

rows.en: Jislaaik, stay inside!
rows.text: Jinne, bly binne!
rows.back: Jeez, stay inside!

rows.en: Free IMAX this morning, boet.
rows.text: Gratis IMAX vanoggend, boet.
rows.back: Free IMAX this morning, bru.

rows.en: Rusks first. Panic later.
rows.text: Beskuit eerste. Paniek later.
rows.back: Rusks first. Panic later.

rows.en: Somewhere a weather reporter is living their best life.
rows.text: Iewers leef 'n weerverslaggewer sy beste lewe.
rows.back: Somewhere a weather reporter is living his best life.

rows.en: The wind has a personal vendetta against umbrellas.
rows.text: Die wind het 'n persoonlike vendetta teen sambrele.
rows.back: The wind has a personal vendetta against umbrellas.

rows.en: The sky is in charge now.
rows.text: Die lug is nou in beheer.
rows.back: The sky is in charge now.

rows.en: Not weather you walk through.
rows.text: Nie weer waardeur jy loop nie.
rows.back: Not weather you walk through.

rows.en: Storm. Plans can wait.
rows.text: Storm. Planne kan wag.
rows.back: Storm. Plans can wait.

rows.en: Outside is closed until further notice.
rows.text: Buite is gesluit tot verdere kennisgewing.
rows.back: Outside is closed until further notice.

rows.en: Thunder rolling in. Inside is the move.
rows.text: Donder kom nader. Binne is die plan.
rows.back: Thunder getting closer. Inside is the plan.

rows.en: Two club selections left: the clubhouse or the car.
rows.text: Nog twee keuses in die sak: die klubhuis of die kar.
rows.back: Two choices left in the bag: the clubhouse or the car.

rows.en: Respect the thunder. It's earned it.
rows.text: Respekteer die donder. Hy het dit verdien.
rows.back: Respect the thunder. He's earned it.

rows.en: Lightning's putting on a show — watch from the window.
rows.text: Weerlig sit 'n show op — kyk deur die venster.
rows.back: Lightning is putting on a show — watch through the window.

rows.en: Nature just reminded us of the pecking order.
rows.text: Natuur maak dit duidelik wie regtig in beheer is.
rows.back: Nature is making it clear who's really in charge.

rows.en: Thunder counts double when you have ears like that.
rows.text: Donderweer tel dubbel as jy sulke ore het.
rows.back: Thunder counts double when you've got ears like that.

rows.en: When the sky starts talking, everything else stops.
rows.text: Wanneer die lug begin praat, hou al die res op.
rows.back: When the sky starts talking, everything else stops.

rows.en: Serious weather. The rest is postponed.
rows.text: Ernstige weer. Die res is uitgestel.
rows.back: Serious weather. Everything else is postponed.

rows.en: Free fireworks, no tickets needed.
rows.text: Gratis vuurwerke, geen kaartjies nodig nie.
rows.back: Free fireworks, no tickets needed.

rows.en: Unplug the things. The sky has plans.
rows.text: Skakel jou toestelle af. Die lug het planne.
rows.back: Switch off your devices. The sky has plans.
rows.reason: EN says unplug ('Unplug the things'); 'Skakel jou toestelle af' says switch off, which drops the lightning-safety point.
reasons: DRIFT: EN says unplug ('Unplug the things'); 'Skakel jou toestelle af' says switch off, which drops the lightning-safety point.

rows.en: The balcony beats the couch when the sky is doing this.
rows.text: Die balkon klop die bank as die lug dít doen.
rows.back: The balcony beats the couch when the sky does this.

rows.en: Lightning's putting Eskom's grid to shame.
rows.text: Weerlig laat Eskom se kragnetwerk pateties lyk.
rows.back: Lightning makes Eskom's power grid look pathetic.

rows.en: Today's forecast: special effects.
rows.text: Vandag se voorspelling: verhoogeffekte.
rows.back: Today's forecast: stage effects.

rows.en: The palms are pointing the way the storm is going, which is this way.
rows.text: Die palms wys die rigting waarheen die storm gaan, en dit is hierheen.
rows.back: The palms show which way the storm is heading, and it's here.

rows.en: Storm on the horizon. That's your deadline.
rows.text: Storm op die horison. Dis jou sperdatum.
rows.back: Storm on the horizon. That's your deadline.

rows.en: Finish up. The weather won't.
rows.text: Maak klaar. Die weer gaan nie klaarmaak nie.
rows.back: Finish up. The weather isn't going to finish up.

rows.en: Storm's close. Home is closer, hopefully.
rows.text: Die storm is naby. Die huis is nader, hopelik.
rows.back: The storm is close. Home is closer, hopefully.

rows.en: Somewhere up there the rain found a way in, and it is being managed.
rows.text: Êrens daarbo het die reën 'n pad ingekry, en dit word hanteer.
rows.back: Somewhere up there the rain found a way in, and it's being handled.
rows.note: unsure: 'n pad ingekry' — found a way in (roof leak)? phrasing odd

rows.en: The braai is cancelled. Yes, really.
rows.text: Die braai is gekanselleer. Ja, regtig.
rows.back: The braai is cancelled. Yes, really.

rows.en: Eskom wishes it had this power.
rows.text: Eskom wens hy het hierdie krag.
rows.back: Eskom wishes it had this power.

rows.en: Nature's doing its own load shedding.
rows.text: Natuur doen sy eie beurtkrag.
rows.back: Nature is doing its own load-shedding.

rows.en: The gutter is telling you exactly how long you left it.
rows.text: Die geut vertel jou presies hoe lank jy dit gelos het.
rows.back: The gutter is telling you exactly how long you've left it.

rows.en: The hose reel is going to feel very unnecessary for a while.
rows.text: Die tuinslanghaspel gaan vir 'n ruk baie onnodig voel.
rows.back: The hose reel is going to feel very unnecessary for a while.

rows.en: Jacaranda season and a Monday, and the paving is taking both badly.
rows.text: Jakarandaseisoen en 'n Maandag, en die plaveisel vat albei sleg.
rows.back: Jacaranda season and a Monday, and the paving is taking both badly.

rows.en: Whoever parked in the street tonight is regretting it right now.
rows.text: Wie ook al vanaand in die straat geparkeer het, is nou spyt.
rows.back: Whoever parked in the street tonight is sorry now.

rows.en: That security light is doing the best work it has done all year.
rows.text: Daardie sekuriteitslig doen die beste werk wat dit die hele jaar gedoen het.
rows.back: That security light is doing the best work it's done all year.

rows.en: The tree has seen worse Tuesdays and it will see worse again.
rows.text: Die boom het erger Dinsdae gesien en gaan weer erger sien.
rows.back: The tree has seen worse Tuesdays and will see worse again.

rows.en: Every gate in this street is shut and every dog has an opinion.
rows.text: Elke hek in hierdie straat is toe en elke hond het 'n mening.
rows.back: Every gate in this street is shut and every dog has an opinion.

rows.en: Somewhere behind those walls a whole street is pretending to sleep.
rows.text: Êrens agter daardie mure maak 'n hele straat asof dit slaap.
rows.back: Somewhere behind those walls a whole street is pretending to sleep.

rows.en: The streetlight is doing overtime that nobody is going to pay for.
rows.text: Die straatlig werk oortyd waarvoor niemand gaan betaal nie.
rows.back: The streetlight is working overtime nobody's going to pay for.

rows.en: Tomorrow morning this road will be covered in somebody else's tree.
rows.text: Môreoggend gaan hierdie pad onder iemand anders se boom lê.
rows.back: Tomorrow morning this road will be lying under someone else's tree.

rows.en: Even the hadedas are quiet.
rows.text: Selfs die hadedas is stil.
rows.back: Even the hadedas are quiet.

rows.en: Midnight and the sky is showing off.
rows.text: Middernag en die lug wys af.
rows.back: Midnight and the sky is showing off.

rows.en: The best television in the house is currently the weather.
rows.text: Die beste televisie in die huis is op die oomblik die weer.
rows.back: The best television in the house right now is the weather.

rows.en: That car made it under the carport with about four minutes to spare.
rows.text: Daardie kar was met omtrent vier minute te spaar onder die afdak.
rows.back: That car made it under the carport with about four minutes to spare.

rows.en: The road is still dry, which is the last thing it will be tonight.
rows.text: Die pad is nog droog, en dis die laaste keer vanaand.
rows.back: The road is still dry, and it's the last time tonight.

rows.en: A Free State storm gives you exactly as much warning as it feels like.
rows.text: 'n Vrystaatse storm gee jou presies soveel waarskuwing soos wat hy lus het.
rows.back: A Free State storm gives you exactly as much warning as it feels like.

rows.en: Everyone on this street is now standing at a window they never use.
rows.text: Almal in hierdie straat staan nou by 'n venster wat hulle nooit gebruik nie.
rows.back: Everyone in this street is now standing at a window they never use.

rows.en: The dust and the rain are about to have a very short argument.
rows.text: Die stof en die reën gaan nou 'n baie kort argument hê.
rows.back: The dust and the rain are about to have a very short argument.

rows.en: Unplug the TV — it's tradition.
rows.text: Onthou om die TV se prop uit te trek — dis tradisie.
rows.back: Remember to unplug the TV — it's tradition.

rows.en: The lightning is putting on a proper show.
rows.text: Die weerlig sit 'n ordentlike show op.
rows.back: The lightning is putting on a proper show.

rows.en: Friday night, and the stoep has quietly become the whole evening.
rows.text: Vrydagaand, en die stoep het stilweg die hele aand geword.
rows.back: Friday evening, and the stoep has quietly become the whole evening.

rows.en: That one bulb is holding this entire building together.
rows.text: Daardie een gloeilamp hou hierdie hele gebou aanmekaar.
rows.back: That one light bulb is holding this whole building together.

rows.en: The polish on that floor was not designed with this much water in mind.
rows.text: Daardie vloer se politoer was nooit vir soveel water bedoel nie.
rows.back: That floor's polish was never meant for this much water.

rows.en: Everything green out there is having the best night of its life.
rows.text: Alles wat groen is daar buite het die beste nag van sy lewe.
rows.back: Everything green out there is having the best night of its life.

rows.en: You can hear the roof better than you can hear the television.
rows.text: Jy kan die dak beter hoor as die televisie.
rows.back: You can hear the roof better than the television.

rows.en: Somewhere a roof is someone's new kite.
rows.text: Iewers is 'n dak iemand se nuwe vlieër.
rows.back: Somewhere a roof is someone's new kite.

rows.en: Rain coming off the roof in one solid sheet: the stoep has a curtain tonight.
rows.text: Reën wat in een soliede laken van die dak afkom: die stoep het vanaand 'n gordyn.
rows.back: Rain coming off the roof in one solid sheet: the stoep has a curtain tonight.

rows.en: Rain was the warning. This is the follow-through.
rows.text: Die reën was die waarskuwing. Dit is die opvolg.
rows.back: The rain was the warning. This is the follow-up.

rows.en: Proper storm. Not the pretty kind.
rows.text: Ordentlike storm. Nie die mooi soort nie.
rows.back: Proper storm. Not the pretty kind.

rows.en: Every flash is a photo nobody takes in time.
rows.text: Elke weerligstraal is 'n foto wat niemand betyds neem nie.
rows.back: Every lightning bolt is a photo nobody takes in time.

rows.en: Get inside weather.
rows.text: Gaan-binne-weer.
rows.back: Go-inside weather.

rows.en: Stay in. That's the whole forecast.
rows.text: Bly binne. Dis die hele voorspelling.
rows.back: Stay inside. That's the whole forecast.

rows.en: The sky just went full Carte Blanche.
rows.text: Die lug het voluit bedonnerd gegaan.
rows.back: The sky has gone full-on bedonnerd.
rows.reason: The SA anchor 'full Carte Blanche' (TV show / free-rein pun) is replaced by a thunder pun ('bedonnerd'); claim still 'sky went all-out' but the reference is gone.
reasons: DRIFT: The SA anchor 'full Carte Blanche' (TV show / free-rein pun) is replaced by a thunder pun ('bedonnerd'); claim still 'sky went all-out' but the reference is gone.

rows.en: Every loose object in the garden has chosen violence.
rows.text: Elke los voorwerp in die tuin het geweld gekies.
rows.back: Every loose object in the garden has chosen violence.

rows.en: Storm with wind attached.
rows.text: Storm. Wind ingesluit.
rows.back: Storm. Wind included.

rows.en: The storm has arrived. Everything else can wait.
rows.text: Die storm het aangekom. Al die res kan wag.
rows.back: The storm has arrived. Everything else can wait.

rows.en: Unsecured objects are now weather.
rows.text: Los goed is nou deel van die weer.
rows.back: Loose stuff is now part of the weather.

rows.en: That grey column is someone’s afternoon getting cancelled. Ours is next in line.
rows.text: Daardie grys kolom is iemand se middag wat gekanselleer word. Ons s'n is volgende.
rows.back: That grey column is someone's afternoon being cancelled. Ours is next.

rows.en: Highveld rain doesn’t arrive. It gets delivered — all at once, one farm at a time.
rows.text: Hoëveldse reën kom nie aan nie. Dit word afgelewer — alles tegelyk, een plaas op 'n slag.
rows.back: Highveld rain doesn't arrive. It's delivered — all at once, one farm at a time.

rows.en: Cancel everything. Even your excuses.
rows.text: Kanselleer alles. Selfs jou verskonings.
rows.back: Cancel everything. Even your excuses.

rows.en: Not the time for hero moves, hey.
rows.text: Nie tyd vir heldedade nie, ne!
rows.back: Not the time for heroics, hey!

rows.en: Hail's down — cover the bakkie.
rows.text: Hael val — gooi iets oor die bakkie.
rows.back: Hail falling — throw something over the bakkie.

rows.en: The sky's having a full-on tantrum.
rows.text: Die lug het n volle vloermoer.
rows.back: The sky is throwing a full-on tantrum.
rows.reason: 'n written without apostrophe ('n volle) — typo only

rows.en: Nature's having a word. Best to listen.
rows.text: Natuur wil 'n woordjie sê. Beste om te luister.
rows.back: Nature wants to have a word. Best to listen.

rows.en: The trees are doing involuntary yoga.
rows.text: Die bome doen onvrywillige yoga.
rows.back: The trees are doing involuntary yoga.

rows.en: That trunk grew crooked because this happens here far more than it doesn't.
rows.text: Daardie stam het skeef gegroei omdat dit hier meestal so waai.
rows.back: That trunk grew crooked because it mostly blows like this here.

rows.en: The palm has been holding that exact shape since about three this morning.
rows.text: Die palm staan al van drieuur vanoggend af presies so.
rows.back: The palm has been standing exactly like this since three o'clock this morning.

rows.en: The Cape Doctor is making house calls.
rows.text: Die Kaapse Dokter maak huisbesoeke.
rows.back: The Cape Doctor is making house calls.

rows.en: The sun is up, the street is empty, and the wind got here first.
rows.text: Die son is op, die straat is leeg, en die wind was eerste hier.
rows.back: The sun's up, the street's empty, and the wind got here first.

rows.en: Table Mountain's tablecloth is out.
rows.text: Tafelberg se tafeldoek is uit.
rows.back: Table Mountain's tablecloth is out.

rows.en: Even the seagulls are walking today.
rows.text: Selfs die meeuë loop vandag.
rows.back: Even the seagulls are walking today.

findings: MEDIUM lexical: 'meeuë' — seen only in this app's own copy, in no external source; closest attested: 'meeue' (4× kaikki/leipzig/hunspell, distance 1)

rows.en: Every one of them is pointing the same way and not one of them chose it.
rows.text: Elkeen van hulle wys dieselfde kant toe en nie een het dit gekies nie.
rows.back: Every one of them is pointing the same way and not one of them chose it.

rows.en: Not one of them is flying, and that is the whole forecast right there.
rows.text: Nie een van hulle vlieg nie, en daar het jy die hele voorspelling.
rows.back: Not one of them is flying, and there you have the whole forecast.

rows.en: The sand is going past them faster than the tide is coming in.
rows.text: Die sand gaan vinniger by hulle verby as wat die gety inkom.
rows.back: The sand is going past them faster than the tide is coming in.

rows.en: They will stand exactly like that until it drops, and it is not dropping.
rows.text: Hulle gaan presies so staan tot dit gaan lê, en dit gaan nie lê nie.
rows.back: They're going to stand exactly like that until it dies down, and it's not going to die down.

rows.en: He was going to have coffee. The mug is still standing on the step.
rows.text: Hy wou koffie drink. Die beker staan nog op die trap.
rows.back: He wanted to have coffee. The mug is still standing on the step.

rows.en: One slipper is already out of the game and the cover is still winning.
rows.text: Een pantoffel is klaar uit die spel en die oortreksel wen steeds.
rows.back: One slipper is already out of the game and the duvet cover is still winning.
rows.note: unsure: 'oortreksel' — duvet cover, or some other cover/slipcover

rows.en: The braai cover is in the next suburb.
rows.text: Die braai-deksel is in die volgende voorstad.
rows.back: The braai lid is in the next suburb.
rows.reason: EN 'braai cover' (fabric cover) became 'braai-deksel' (braai lid) — a different object, may not match the photo; 1339 used 'oortreksel' for cover
reasons: DRIFT: EN 'braai cover' (fabric cover) became 'braai-deksel' (braai lid) — a different object, may not match the photo; 1339 used 'oortreksel' for cover

rows.en: The pine behind him is bent right over, so this was never a fair contest.
rows.text: Die den agter hom is heeltemal oorgebuig, so dit was nooit 'n regverdige wedstryd nie.
rows.back: The pine behind him is bent right over, so it was never a fair match.

rows.en: Perfect conditions for losing your dignity.
rows.text: Perfekte toestande om jou waardigheid te verloor.
rows.back: Perfect conditions for losing your dignity.

rows.en: Ponytail holders are doing overtime.
rows.text: Poniestert-rekkies doen oortyd.
rows.back: Ponytail elastics are working overtime.

rows.en: She is leaning at an angle that a flat path does not normally require.
rows.text: Sy leun skuinser as wat 'n plat paadjie ooit behoort te vra.
rows.back: She's leaning at a steeper angle than a flat path should ever ask for.

rows.en: She will be picking grass seeds out of that jacket until Saturday.
rows.text: Sy gaan tot Saterdag grassade uit daardie baadjie uithaal.
rows.back: She'll be picking grass seeds out of that jacket until Saturday.

rows.en: Thursday, and she is the only thing on this road not going sideways.
rows.text: Donderdag, en sy is die enigste ding op hierdie pad wat nie sywaarts gaan nie.
rows.back: Thursday, and she's the only thing on this road not going sideways.

rows.en: Half the hedge is in the air in front of her and still arriving.
rows.text: Die helfte van die heining is in die lug voor haar en kom nog steeds aan.
rows.back: Half the hedge is in the air in front of her and it's still coming.

rows.en: Your hairstyle took one look and went back to bed.
rows.text: Jou haarstyl het een kyk gevat en teruggegaan bed toe.
rows.back: Your hairstyle took one look and went back to bed.

rows.en: Those sheets will be dry before she has pegged the last one on the line.
rows.text: Daardie lakens gaan droog wees voor sy die laaste een opgehang het.
rows.back: Those sheets will be dry before she's hung up the last one.

findings: MEDIUM semantic: 'voor' means 'before; in front of; furrow' — nothing in the English source; it is 1 letter from 'voer', the usual word for 'line'

rows.en: There are more pegs on that line than the washing needs, and she knows why.
rows.text: Daar is meer pennetjies op daardie draad as wat die wasgoed nodig het, en sy weet hoekom.
rows.back: There are more pegs on that line than the washing needs, and she knows why.

rows.en: Everything on that line is going to smell like the sea by eight o'clock.
rows.text: Alles op daardie draad gaan teen agtuur na die see ruik.
rows.back: Everything on that line will smell of the sea by eight o'clock.

rows.en: The one on the end has come loose and she has not spotted it yet.
rows.text: Die een op die punt het losgekom en sy het dit nog nie gesien nie.
rows.back: The one on the end has come loose and she hasn't seen it yet.

rows.en: Friday, and the wind is doing half of this job for her, free of charge.
rows.text: Vrydag, en die wind doen die helfte van hierdie werk vir haar, gratis.
rows.back: Friday, and the wind is doing half of this job for her, for free.

rows.en: The paving is soaked in front of them and it has not rained once.
rows.text: Die plaveisel voor hulle is deurweek en dit het nie een keer gereën nie.
rows.back: The paving in front of them is soaked and it hasn't rained once.

rows.en: Saturday morning, and the sea has already been over that railing twice.
rows.text: Saterdagoggend, en die see was al twee keer oor daardie reling.
rows.back: Saturday morning, and the sea has already been over that railing twice.

rows.en: Neither of them is going to be the one who suggests turning back.
rows.text: Nie een van hulle gaan die een wees wat voorstel om om te draai nie.
rows.back: Not one of them is going to be the one who suggests turning back.

rows.en: That sea wall is doing its absolute best and it is still losing.
rows.text: Daardie seemuur doen sy uiterste bes en verloor steeds.
rows.back: That sea wall is doing its absolute best and still losing.

rows.en: They will be getting salt off those shoes for the rest of the weekend.
rows.text: Hulle gaan die res van die naweek sout van daardie skoene afkry.
rows.back: They'll be getting salt off those shoes for the rest of the weekend.

rows.en: Everyone's jogging at a slight angle this morning.
rows.text: Almal draf vanoggend teen 'n effense hoek.
rows.back: Everyone's jogging at a slight angle this morning.

rows.en: That wave landed on the promenade about four seconds before she got there.
rows.text: Daardie golf het omtrent vier sekondes voor sy daar was op die promenade geland.
rows.back: That wave landed on the promenade about four seconds before she got there.

rows.en: Sunday morning, and the sea is throwing the first half of it at her.
rows.text: Sondagoggend, en die see gooi alles wat hy het na haar toe.
rows.back: Sunday morning, and the sea is throwing everything it's got at her.
rows.reason: EN 'throwing the first half of it at her' (more still to come) became 'alles wat hy het' (everything it's got) — the 'first half' joke is gone
reasons: DRIFT: EN 'throwing the first half of it at her' (more still to come) became 'alles wat hy het' (everything it's got) — the 'first half' joke is gone

rows.en: She will be tasting salt for the rest of the day and she knows it.
rows.text: Sy gaan die res van die dag sout proe en sy weet dit.
rows.back: She's going to taste salt for the rest of the day and she knows it.

rows.en: The palm is bent double and she is out here smiling about it.
rows.text: Die palm is krom gewaai en sy staan hier buite en glimlag.
rows.back: The palm is blown bent and she's standing out here smiling.

rows.en: The promenade is empty in both directions and there is a reason for that.
rows.text: Die promenade is leeg in albei rigtings en daar is 'n rede daarvoor.
rows.back: The promenade is empty in both directions and there's a reason for that.

rows.en: That hood would be halfway down the road if her hand was not on it.
rows.text: Daardie kap sou al halfpad in die straat af wees as haar hand nie daarop was nie.
rows.back: That hood would be halfway down the street by now if her hand weren't on it.
rows.note: unsure: 'kap' — hood (of a jacket) or cap/bonnet

rows.en: Half the pavement is airborne and only one of the three is enjoying it.
rows.text: Die helfte van die sypaadjie is in die lug en net een van die drie geniet dit.
rows.back: Half the pavement is in the air and only one of the three is enjoying it.

rows.en: That bag is working as a sail and he has not worked that out yet.
rows.text: Daardie sak werk soos 'n seil en hy het dit nog nie agtergekom nie.
rows.back: That bag is working like a sail and he hasn't noticed yet.

rows.en: Every leaf the tree dropped this month is going past them at head height.
rows.text: Elke blaar wat die boom hierdie maand laat val het, gaan op kophoogte by hulle verby.
rows.back: Every leaf that tree has dropped this month is going past them at head height.

rows.en: Monday, and the wind is the best thing that has happened to him so far.
rows.text: Maandag, en die wind is die beste ding wat tot dusver met hom gebeur het.
rows.back: Monday, and the wind is the best thing that's happened to him so far.

rows.en: Hold onto your hat! And your kids.
rows.text: Hou jou hoed vas! En jou kinders.
rows.back: Hold on to your hat! And your kids.

rows.en: Both hands are on the skirt, which means the hair is on its own.
rows.text: Albei hande is op die romp, wat beteken die hare is op sy eie.
rows.back: Both hands are on the skirt, which means the hair is on its own.

rows.en: Table Mountain is right behind her and she cannot see a single bit of it.
rows.text: Tafelberg is reg agter haar en sy kan nie 'n enkele stukkie daarvan sien nie.
rows.back: Table Mountain is right behind her and she can't see a single bit of it.

rows.en: That shoe is coming off next and she has run out of hands.
rows.text: Daardie skoen is volgende, en sy het nie meer hande oor nie.
rows.back: That shoe is next, and she's got no hands left.

rows.en: The leaves going past her were still on a tree two streets ago.
rows.text: Die blare wat by haar verbygaan was twee strate gelede nog aan 'n boom.
rows.back: The leaves going past her were still on a tree two streets ago.

rows.en: Tuesday, and the wind has strong opinions about somebody else's outfit.
rows.text: Dinsdag, en die wind het sterk menings oor iemand anders se uitrusting.
rows.back: Tuesday, and the wind has strong opinions about someone else's outfit.

rows.en: Not a hairstyle in sight. Just survivors.
rows.text: Nie 'n haarstyl in sig nie. Net oorlewendes.
rows.back: Not a hairstyle in sight. Only survivors.

rows.en: Wednesday, and the driveway has become a full contact sport.
rows.text: Woensdag, en die oprit het 'n volkontaksport geword.
rows.back: Wednesday, and the driveway has become a full-contact sport.

rows.en: Somebody will be picking leaves out of that back seat for a week.
rows.text: Iemand gaan vir 'n week blare uit daardie agtersitplek uithaal.
rows.back: Someone will be pulling leaves out of that back seat for a week.

rows.en: That door is going to shut whether he is ready or not.
rows.text: Daardie deur gaan toeslaan of hy gereed is of nie.
rows.back: That door is going to slam shut whether he's ready or not.
rows.note: 'hy' ambiguous — could be the door itself or a man

rows.en: The wind opened it faster than he did and he is still laughing.
rows.text: Die wind het dit vinniger as hy oopgemaak en hy lag nog steeds.
rows.back: The wind opened it faster than he did and he's still laughing.

rows.en: Every leaf in the street is queueing to get into that car.
rows.text: Elke blaar in die straat staan tou om in daardie kar te kom.
rows.back: Every leaf in the street is queuing to get into that car.

rows.en: Your car door just became a weapon.
rows.text: Jou kardeur het net 'n wapen geword.
rows.back: Your car door just became a weapon.

rows.en: The braids have made the decision and she is going along with it.
rows.text: Die vlegsels het die besluit geneem en sy gaan maar saam.
rows.back: The braids made the decision and she's just going along with it.

rows.en: That photo is going to look completely different to how it feels.
rows.text: Daardie foto gaan heeltemal anders lyk as wat dit voel.
rows.back: That photo is going to look completely different from how it feels.

rows.en: Thursday, and somebody has decided to enjoy this instead of complaining.
rows.text: Donderdag, en iemand het besluit om dit te geniet eerder as om te kla.
rows.back: Thursday, and someone decided to enjoy it rather than complain.

rows.en: The phone is the only thing out here being held still.
rows.text: Die foon is die enigste ding hier buite wat stil gehou word.
rows.back: The phone is the only thing out here being held still.

rows.en: Everyone else on this promenade went home about twenty minutes ago.
rows.text: Almal anders op hierdie promenade is omtrent twintig minute gelede huis toe.
rows.back: Everyone else on this promenade went home about twenty minutes ago.

rows.en: Your hairstyle? Gone. Accept it.
rows.text: Jou haarstyl? Weg. Aanvaar dit.
rows.back: Your hairstyle? Gone. Accept it.

rows.en: Those eyes are not closed because of the sun.
rows.text: Daardie oë is nie toe oor die son nie.
rows.back: Those eyes aren't shut because of the sun.

rows.en: Friday, and the aloes have not noticed anything unusual at all.
rows.text: Vrydag, en die aalwyne het glad niks ongewoons opgemerk nie.
rows.back: Friday, and the aloes haven't noticed anything unusual at all.

rows.en: The trees at the fence are taking this worse than he is.
rows.text: Die bome by die heining vat dit erger as hy.
rows.back: The trees by the hedge are taking it worse than he is.

rows.en: He will sit there until something more interesting happens, which it will not.
rows.text: Hy gaan daar sit tot iets interessanters gebeur, en dit gaan nie gebeur nie.
rows.back: He's going to sit there until something more interesting happens, and it's not going to happen.

rows.en: That coat is being parted by something other than a brush.
rows.text: Daardie pels kry 'n paadjie van iets anders as 'n borsel.
rows.back: That fur is getting a parting from something other than a brush.

rows.en: That washing will be dry before she has finished carrying the rest of it out.
rows.text: Daardie wasgoed gaan droog wees voor sy klaar is om die res uit te dra.
rows.back: That washing will be dry before she's finished carrying the rest out.

rows.en: She is not looking at the washing, she is looking at where it might land.
rows.text: Sy kyk nie na die wasgoed nie, sy kyk waar dit dalk gaan land.
rows.back: She's not looking at the washing, she's looking at where it might land.

rows.en: Saturday, and the only thing on that line doing any work is the pegs.
rows.text: Saterdag, en die enigste ding op daardie draad wat werk doen is die pennetjies.
rows.back: Saturday, and the only thing on that line doing any work is the pegs.

rows.en: Nobody is lighting that Weber until this drops, and everyone in the yard knows it.
rows.text: Niemand steek daardie Weber aan voor dit gaan lê nie, en almal op die werf weet dit.
rows.back: Nobody is lighting that Weber before it dies down, and everyone in the yard knows it.

rows.en: The Weber has not been lit once this week and today is not the day.
rows.text: Die Weber is hierdie week nie een keer aangesteek nie en vandag is nie die dag nie.
rows.back: The Weber hasn't been lit once this week and today isn't the day.

rows.en: Everything on that line was dry ten minutes ago. The wind is just showing off now.
rows.text: Alles op daardie draad was tien minute gelede al droog. Die wind spog nou net.
rows.back: Everything on that line was already dry ten minutes ago. The wind's just showing off now.

rows.en: Two pegs a shirt today. Anything less is a donation to the neighbours.
rows.text: Twee pennetjies per hemp vandag. Enigiets minder is 'n skenking aan die bure.
rows.back: Two pegs per shirt today. Anything less is a donation to the neighbours.

rows.en: That walk was somebody else's idea and the dog is registering a complaint.
rows.text: Daardie stap was iemand anders se idee en die hond lê 'n klag in.
rows.back: That walk was someone else's idea and the dog is lodging a complaint.

rows.en: Sunday, and this is about as far as either of them is going.
rows.text: Sondag, en verder as dit gaan nie een van hulle nie.
rows.back: Sunday, and not one of them is going any further than that.

rows.en: The lead is doing considerably more work than it was designed for.
rows.text: Die leiband doen heelwat meer werk as waarvoor dit ontwerp is.
rows.back: The leash is doing a lot more work than it was designed for.

rows.en: He is going to shake all that sand out on the lounge carpet later.
rows.text: Hy gaan al daardie sand later op die sitkamermat uitskud.
rows.back: He's going to shake all that sand out onto the lounge rug later.

rows.en: The sea has gone white all the way out and he noticed before anyone.
rows.text: Die see het heeltemal wit geword tot ver uit, en hy het dit voor almal opgemerk.
rows.back: The sea has gone completely white far out, and he noticed it before anyone else.

rows.en: The mountain looks like that about six evenings a year and this is one.
rows.text: Die berg lyk omtrent ses aande 'n jaar so, en dit is een van hulle.
rows.back: The mountain looks like this about six evenings a year, and this is one of them.

rows.en: They came out for the sunset and are staying for it despite everything.
rows.text: Hulle het vir die sonsondergang gekom, en hulle bly, wat die wind ook al doen.
rows.back: They came for the sunset, and they're staying, whatever the wind does.

rows.en: Monday, and the wind has completely failed to ruin this.
rows.text: Maandag, en die wind kon dit glad nie bederf nie.
rows.back: Monday, and the wind couldn't spoil it at all.

rows.en: Nobody's hair is going to survive, and nobody is leaving yet.
rows.text: Niemand se hare gaan dit oorleef nie, en niemand loop nog nie.
rows.back: Nobody's hair is going to survive this, and nobody's leaving yet.

rows.en: Lion's Head is doing the scenery and the wind is doing the comedy.
rows.text: Leeukop sorg vir die uitsig en die wind vir die komedie.
rows.back: Lion's Head supplies the view and the wind supplies the comedy.

rows.en: That jacket has been trying to leave since he got on the bike.
rows.text: Daardie baadjie probeer wegkom vandat hy op die fiets geklim het.
rows.back: That jacket has been trying to escape since he got on the bike.

rows.en: The jacarandas are throwing everything they have at one cyclist.
rows.text: Die jakarandas gooi alles wat hulle het na een fietsryer.
rows.back: The jacarandas are throwing everything they've got at one cyclist.

rows.en: Tuesday evening, and the ride home has turned into a negotiation.
rows.text: Dinsdagaand, en die rit huis toe het 'n onderhandeling geword.
rows.back: Tuesday evening, and the ride home has turned into a negotiation.

rows.en: He is going downhill and still working for every metre of it.
rows.text: Hy ry afdraand en werk steeds vir elke meter daarvan.
rows.back: He's riding downhill and still working for every metre of it.

rows.en: The blossom is coming off those trees faster than he is going under them.
rows.text: Die blomme kom vinniger van daardie bome af as wat hy onderdeur ry.
rows.back: The blossoms are coming off those trees faster than he can ride under them.

rows.en: This is the second time this week and they have a system now.
rows.text: Dit is die tweede keer hierdie week en hulle het nou 'n stelsel.
rows.back: This is the second time this week and they've got a system now.

rows.en: The pegs lost, the wall won, and the neighbours are still laughing.
rows.text: Die wasgoedpennetjies het verloor, die muur het gewen, en die bure lag nog.
rows.back: The clothes pegs lost, the wall won, and the neighbours are still laughing.

rows.en: Nobody is ever going to find that one white sock again.
rows.text: Niemand gaan ooit daardie een wit sokkie weer kry nie.
rows.back: Nobody is ever going to find that one white sock again.

rows.en: The wind did the throwing and the neighbour is doing the returning.
rows.text: Die wind het gegooi en die buurvrou gooi terug.
rows.back: The wind threw it over and the lady next door is throwing it back.
rows.reason: 'buurvrou' specifies a woman where EN says 'the neighbour' — fine if the photo agrees

rows.en: One gust, one wall, and two households now know each other much better.
rows.text: Een windvlaag, een muur, en twee huishoudings ken mekaar nou heelwat beter.
rows.back: One gust, one wall, and two households know each other a lot better now.

rows.en: Your washing just moved to the neighbour's yard.
rows.text: Jou wasgoed het na die buurman se erf getrek.
rows.back: Your washing has moved over to the neighbour's plot.

rows.en: That tree has been shaped by one wind for about forty years.
rows.text: Daardie boom is omtrent veertig jaar lank deur een wind gevorm.
rows.back: That tree was shaped by one wind over about forty years.

rows.en: The washing goes out at this hour because wind is cheaper than electricity.
rows.text: Die wasgoed gaan hierdie tyd uit omdat wind goedkoper as elektrisiteit is.
rows.back: The washing goes out at this time because wind is cheaper than electricity.

rows.en: The lagoon has gone flat and silver, which fools nobody who lives here.
rows.text: Die strandmeer het plat en silwer geword, wat niemand wat hier woon flous nie.
rows.back: The lagoon has gone flat and silver, which fools nobody who lives here.

rows.en: Everything on this street leans the same way, including the people.
rows.text: Alles in hierdie straat leun dieselfde kant toe, die mense inkluis.
rows.back: Everything in this street leans the same way, people included.

rows.en: Thursday evening, and the only thing still moving out here is the line.
rows.text: Donderdagaand, en die enigste ding wat hier buite nog beweeg is die wasgoeddraad.
rows.back: Thursday evening, and the only thing still moving out here is the washing line.

rows.en: Bo-Kaap in the last light, and the wind is doing the housekeeping.
rows.text: Bo-Kaap in die laaste lig, en die wind doen die huishouding.
rows.back: Bo-Kaap in the last light, and the wind is doing the housework.

rows.en: That curtain has been outside the window for about an hour now.
rows.text: Daardie gordyn hang nou al omtrent 'n uur buite die venster.
rows.back: That curtain has been hanging outside the window for about an hour now.

rows.en: The south-easter has found the one open window on the whole street.
rows.text: Die suidooster het die een oop venster in die hele straat gekry.
rows.back: The south-easter found the one open window in the whole street.

rows.en: Somebody is going to come home to a lounge full of Signal Hill.
rows.text: Iemand gaan by 'n sitkamer vol Seinheuwel tuiskom.
rows.back: Someone is going to come home to a lounge full of Signal Hill.

rows.en: The paint is bright, the hill is gold, and the wind is the loudest thing here.
rows.text: Die verf is helder, die heuwel is goud, en die wind is die hardste ding hier.
rows.back: The paint is bright, the hill is gold, and the wind is the loudest thing here.

rows.en: That hair was a decision made indoors about forty minutes ago.
rows.text: Daardie hare was 'n besluit wat omtrent veertig minute gelede binne geneem is.
rows.back: That hair was a decision made indoors about forty minutes ago.

rows.en: Saturday evening, and the walk from the front door defeated the whole look.
rows.text: Saterdagaand, en die stap van die voordeur af het die hele look verwoes.
rows.back: Saturday evening, and the walk from the front door wrecked the whole look.

rows.en: Her hair is going one way, the palm is going the same way, and neither was asked.
rows.text: Haar hare gaan een kant toe, die palm gaan dieselfde kant toe, en nie een is gevra nie.
rows.back: Her hair goes one way, the palm goes the same way, and nobody asked either of them.

rows.en: Twelve steps from the front door to the car, and the wind took all twelve.
rows.text: Twaalf treë van die voordeur tot by die kar, en die wind het al twaalf gevat.
rows.back: Twelve steps from the front door to the car, and the wind took all twelve.

rows.en: That driveway was swept this morning and has already been refilled.
rows.text: Daardie oprit is vanoggend gevee en lê al weer vol.
rows.back: That driveway was swept this morning and it's full again already.

rows.en: Sand in places sand should never be.
rows.text: Sand in plekke waar sand nooit moet wees nie.
rows.back: Sand in places sand should never be.

rows.en: Neither of them can stand up straight and neither of them seems to mind.
rows.text: Nie een van hulle kan regop staan nie en nie een lyk of hulle omgee nie.
rows.back: Not one of them can stand up straight and not one of them looks like they care.

rows.en: The footprints behind them are already filling in and they only just walked there.
rows.text: Die spore agter hulle vul reeds toe en hulle het nou net daar geloop.
rows.back: The footprints behind them are already filling in and they only just walked there.

rows.en: The beach itself is moving faster than they are, and in the same direction.
rows.text: Die strand self beweeg vinniger as hulle, en in dieselfde rigting.
rows.back: The beach itself is moving faster than they are, and in the same direction.

rows.en: The moon is out and the palms have not stopped moving since sunset.
